ALDER PEAK ROBOTICS, INC.
STOCK OPTION GRANT NOTICE
Grant No. APR-2027-0113

Optionee: Jordan Vale
Date of Grant: February 17, 2027
Type of Option: Non-Qualified Stock Option
The Company hereby grants you an option to purchase 40,000 shares of Common Stock at an exercise price of $1.85 per share.
The option vests over 48 months, with a 12 month cliff.
Following your termination of service, you may exercise vested shares within 90 days after your last day of service.
